title: A first look at first stages of my Dark fantasy Action Roguelite game
author: Icy_Piece3257
selftext:
Hi!

I love making games, and I have actually been part of teams that have build games ( without using Ai to be clear)   
so before I introduce the game itself I wanted to say why I used ai to help with my work at first place.   
as many of you know, the biggest reason is time and budget, I had found teams to build games but those cases where for games that they saw potential and they saw the actual benefit of it doing it. here? as much as I would've loved it to be the same but not even myself have the all the time to put for it and work on it. so Ai here helped me to at least get the prototype and some parts of the game set up, maybe maybe that would attract other passionate people as well.

so what even is the game? well as you can see by its gameplay its a Action Roguelite game thats set in a dark fantasy theme world. It has some unique game modes like pvp or mechanics like dash or evolutions ( not all unique here tbf ). 

I have worked on the story mostly that has a vast world and story but in the game itself you probably would not see all of it.

I started the game mostly to test Ai to see how much they can do and go forward, and the thing that I got back was actually fun to play not just for myself but for the people I gave them to test it as well, so I told myself "Why not make it an actual game?" and here we are trying to push forward with it.

the UI and art are not even close to finish, they are mostly a placeholders and something to be there so I could later on replace with an actual art ( hopefully human made if I get the people for helping me with this ).

What are my plan? well I would just build as much as I can and probably give show more of the game progression as I go, maybe some people get interested in it and give me the energy to push more with it. what I would aim mostly is to actually find a team of passionate people that could actually help me with the game so I could overall get off the Ai and use human for it, but until then I guess I just get as much of it as I can.

  
And since you are all the way here, the game title for now is HellZone, its sticky name but I really dont like it, any dark fantasy names you could suggest? I would love to see a few.

comments.author: DependentAction3195
comments.body: Seems like you took reference from vampire survivers. if so maybe you can name it something related to vampires? Or perhaps something related to gods. I believe I have seen a number of similar games with names related to gods.

replies.author: Icy_Piece3257
replies.body: Yeah it does have similarities to it. But there is no vampires, the story for this game is a world getting invaded by another and champions of that world are trying to defend it.
